class TeachingScene(Scene):

        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            'This identity links exponential growth to circular rotation.',
            'It underpins modern physics, signal processing, and waves.',
            'Complexity simplifies into this one elegant truth.'
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Conclusion: Synthesis and Impact", lecture_lines)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight first line
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFFF00")
        
        # Unit circle and rotating vector
        circle = Circle(radius=1.0, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(circle, "B2", "D3", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # Complex Plane axes (simplified)
        h_line = Line(circle.get_left(), circle.get_right(), color=GRAY, stroke_width=1)
        v_line = Line(circle.get_bottom(), circle.get_top(), color=GRAY, stroke_width=1)
        plane_elements = VGroup(circle, h_line, v_line)
        
        # Sine wave container in Area B4 to D6
        wave_start = self.grid["C4"]
        
        theta_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        
        # Rotating Vector
        vector = Line(circle.get_center(), circle.get_center() + RIGHT, color=YELLOW)
        vector.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_angle(theta_tracker.get_value()))
        
        # Sine wave
        wave = VMobject(color=YELLOW)

            points = []
            t_val = theta_tracker.get_value()
            for x_offset in np.linspace(0, 2.5, 50):
                y = 0.8 * np.sin(x_offset * 3 - t_val)
                points.append(wave_start + np.array([x_offset, y, 0]))
            obj.set_points_as_corners(points)
        
        wave.add_updater(update_wave)
        
        # Connecting projection line
        proj_line = Line(color=GRAY, stroke_dash_array=[0.1, 0.1])
        proj_line.add_updater(lambda m: m.put_start_and_end_on(
            vector.get_end(), 
            wave_start + np.array([0, 0.8 * np.sin(-theta_tracker.get_value()), 0])
        ))

        self.play(Create(plane_elements), Create(vector))
        self.add(wave, proj_line)
        self.play(theta_tracker.animate.set_value(TAU * 2), run_time=4, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===

        label_sp = Text("Signal Processing", font_size=18, color="#00FFFF")
        label_qw = Text("Quantum Waves", font_size=18, color="#00FFFF")
        
        self.place_at_grid(label_sp, "A5", scale_factor=1.0)
        self.place_at_grid(label_qw, "E5", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(label_sp), FadeIn(label_qw))
        self.play(theta_tracker.animate.increment_value(TAU * 1.5), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FFFFFF")
        
        final_formula = MathTex("e^{i\\pi} + 1 = 0", font_size=72, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(final_formula, "B2", "E5", scale_factor=1.2)
        
        self.play(
